key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:0000
name: invoke_unnamed_routine_and_return
description: Diskfont.library entry that makes a single call to an unnamed routine and then returns, with no other work visible. It is reached through a handler pointer stored in data.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:0012
name: dispatch_unnamed_routine_call
description: Small diskfont.library entry that calls one unnamed routine through a pointer and returns. The pseudo-code shows only that call and the return, so it passes control straight on.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:0:0000
name: launch_program_via_two_calls
description: Program entry point in the nick.a file, 33 instructions long, reached through an address-taken reference and the program entry. The decompiled body is unavailable, so the visible facts are that it calls two unnamed routines and is called by one.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:0:00B0
name: save_and_install_self_handler
description: Saves a previous value, writes a pointer to itself into a library slot, and fetches a structure through a library call whose field is then pointed at a global variable. It ends with an indirect call and a return.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:0:00F8
name: call_library_then_install_handler
description: Calls a library entry first, then stores a pointer to itself into a library slot, points a structure field at a global variable, and makes an indirect call before returning. It follows the same install pattern as its neighbour at the next offset.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:0:00FE
name: detach_slot_into_global
description: Reads a pointer from a slot in the data area. When it is non-null and not the sentinel, it clears that record's field at offset four and stores the pointer with its top bit set in a global. It then resets the slot to the sentinel and returns.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:3:0000
name: setup_screen_and_wait
description: Opens dos.library and intuition.library, sets fixed values in a display structure, and waits until two screen coordinate fields reach 640 and 256. It then closes the libraries through exec calls and returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:3:00D8
name: write_byte_then_wait_flag
description: Writes one byte taken from the preceding byte of an input pointer to a destination pointer, then busy-waits while bit 6 of a global variable stays set. It returns the byte register value.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:nick.a:4:0000
name: wait_until_ciaa_bit_clear
description: Spins while bit 6 of a global variable is set, which the listing associates with the CIAA port that carries the fire buttons and disk status, and then returns. Its only action is this wait loop.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:0000
name: load_hunks_and_relocate
description: Program-entry loader that walks the executable's hunk records, allocates memory for code and data hunks with AllocMem, and applies 32-bit relocation entries until it reaches the end marker. It then frees scratch memory and returns the result.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:0138
name: busy_wait_on_counter
description: Loops decrementing the 16-bit counter in register D1 until it wraps around, burning a number of iterations set by the caller. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:017A
name: return_without_action
description: A single return instruction with no other work. It is used as an address-taken pointer and is called by one unnamed routine.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:017C
name: decode_backward_run_copy
description: Decodes packed data backwards into a buffer from its end. It reads bit-coded counts from routines, emits single bytes in one case and copies earlier output as runs in the other, with the values 3 and 7 extending run lengths. It returns when the output pointer reaches the buffer start.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:01C8
name: shift_bits_refilling_stream
description: Reads bits from a stream into an accumulator one count at a time, loading the next longword from memory whenever the bit buffer empties. It loops on the word counter in D0 and the listing also touches the BPLCON1 scroll register.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:game:0:021C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains a trap instruction followed by undecodable bytes, so the decompiler truncates it. It is only bad instruction data and shows no behaviour beyond that.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:Crystal:0:0000
name: read_packed_bits_set_color
description: Program entry in the Crystal file that calls the bit-buffer refill and multi-bit read routines to decode a packed stream, and writes the COLOR00 background colour register. The decompiled body is unavailable, so this rests on those calls and that register write.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:0:0000
name: check_signature_then_install
description: Program entry in the rinstall file that first checks a magic word at a fixed address. When it does not match, it allocates memory, copies a 256-longword block into it and calls two library routines. It then calls further routines and returns their result.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:0:0064
name: return_fixed_constant_value
description: Returns the fixed value 1192 in the result register and does no other work. The listing gives no clue to what the constant stands for.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0000
name: clear_state_and_open_font
description: Clears a block of global state, then tries to open the font file RAILA:fonts/railf0.font through the DOS library, either using a preset file or building a quoted path from the argument text. It allocates a buffer when needed and cleans up through library calls.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:017C
name: cleanup_close_handles_and_reply
description: Stores its result argument and runs an optional callback. It then either frees the buffer and closes the DOS file and lock handles, or calls the library close entries. It finishes with exec Forbid and ReplyMsg calls and returns the stored result.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:01F8
name: call_library_vector_entry
description: Calls a library entry through a pointer read from a value on the stack at a fixed negative offset, then returns. Nothing else appears in the pseudo-code.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:022C
name: return_immediately_only
description: A single return instruction with no other work. One unnamed routine calls it.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:022E
name: return_immediately_alone
description: A single return instruction with no other work. One unnamed routine calls it, and the listing shows no further use.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0230
name: lookup_stream_then_forward
description: Looks up a stream record through a routine and returns minus one if it is missing. Otherwise it repositions the stream when a flag bit is set, then forwards the call with the record's inner handle and returns minus one if an error flag is set afterwards.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0298
name: emit_string_into_buffer
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and writes each character into a buffer while a remaining-space counter stays positive. When the count runs out it sends the character to a routine instead. It finishes by sending an end-of-input marker and returns the string length.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0300
name: parse_args_and_open_console
description: Splits a command line into words, honouring quoted strings and star escapes for a newline and a control code, and stores the word pointers in an argument table. It then opens a console window from the con specification or the NIL device and sets up input and output handles through dos.Input, dos.Open, dos.Output and exec.FindTask.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0560
name: write_fixed_fields_to_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and writes a long fixed sequence of text and byte fields to it through the file handle. It loops over a table of further entries, writing each one, and begins with a stack-limit check that appends a string under a length limit.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0578
name: initialise_stream_record_fields
description: When a record's size field is zero or its flag bit is set, it fetches a value through a routine and stores it into the record's pointer fields, clearing the flag and counters. A zero result stores the error code 12 in a global and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:05D4
name: write_char_buffered_with_crlf
description: Writes one character into a stream buffer, inserting a carriage return before a line feed, and tracks the remaining space in the stream record. When the buffer is full it passes the character to a write call instead. It sets error flags when a write comes up short and returns the character or minus one on error.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0864
name: close_open_records_in_reverse
description: Walks the table of open records from last to first and passes each record whose first byte is set and whose bit 4 is clear to a routine. It then makes a final call with its argument.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:08C0
name: append_bounded_text_checked
description: Appends a source string to a destination string under a length limit, finding both ends first and then null-terminating the result. It saves and restores registers around the copy and returns the destination pointer.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:08DC
name: concatenate_limited_string
description: Appends up to a given number of bytes from a source string to the end of a destination string, then writes a zero terminator and returns the destination. It finds both string ends before copying.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0934
name: calculate_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0948
name: compare_c_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns zero when they match, one when the first is greater at the first difference, and minus one when it is smaller.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0968
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a block of memory to a free list kept in address order, rounding its size up to whole longwords with a minimum of eight bytes. It merges the block with touching neighbours and returns zero on success, or minus one when the block overlaps an existing free block.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0A60
name: lookup_record_then_forward
description: Looks up a record through a routine and returns minus one if none is found. Otherwise it forwards the call with the record's inner handle and returns minus one if an error flag is set afterwards.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0AA8
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Finds the first unused entry in a table of open records from index three upward. If none is free it records error code 24 and returns minus one. Otherwise it opens the file with one of several mode values and stores the handle and position in that entry.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0C28
name: create_directory_save_error
description: Creates a directory through the DOS library. When creation fails it saves the DOS error code in a global and returns minus one. On success it unlocks the returned lock and returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0C64
name: free_linked_allocations_list
description: Walks a linked list of allocations, freeing each node with the exec FreeMem call, then clears the list head and count fields and returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0C94
name: allocate_block_with_header
description: Releases any block pending in a stored pointer, then for a non-zero size allocates the size plus a four-byte header through a routine. It records the size in the header and returns a pointer just past it, or null for a zero size or a failed allocation.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0CE0
name: lookup_entry_and_forward_call
description: Looks up a record through a routine and returns minus one if none is found. Otherwise it forwards the call with the record's inner handle and returns minus one if an error flag is set afterwards.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0D28
name: allocate_tracked_node
description: Allocates a node of the requested size plus a header through the exec AllocMem call, records the size and links the node into a list of tracked allocations. It returns a pointer just past the header, or null when allocation fails.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0D94
name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of at least the requested size, rounded up to whole longwords with a minimum of eight bytes. It searches a free list in address order first, splitting a larger block when the remainder is at least eight bytes. Otherwise it requests a larger block through a routine, returns the surplus to the free list and allocates from that.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0E58
name: store_pending_block_pointer
description: Stores a pending block pointer for later release. For a non-zero pointer it first calls a routine with a zero argument and then records the pointer minus four in the pending slot, returning that routine's result. It returns zero for a null pointer.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0E80
name: flush_pending_stream_writes
description: Walks a table of stream records and, for each one with flag value 2 set and flag value 4 clear that still has unwritten bytes, passes the pending bytes to a write routine. It then calls a final routine with its argument.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0ED4
name: write_bytes_with_error_capture
description: Calls the DOS Write through a stored vector and returns its result. A failed write of minus one saves the DOS error code and sets error code 5. A stored callback runs first when one is set.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0F20
name: seek_stream_position_checked
description: Wraps the DOS Seek call and saves the DOS error code with error code 22 when it fails. The offset is adjusted by the current position for one whence value, and the resulting position is returned.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0F94
name: read_bytes_with_error_capture
description: Calls the DOS Read through a stored vector and returns the byte count. A failed read of minus one saves the DOS error code and sets error code 5.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:0FE0
name: open_file_record_error_code
description: Calls the DOS Open through a stored vector. When the handle is zero it saves the DOS error code, stores error code 2 and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns the handle.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1028
name: probe_file_lock_or_open
description: Tries a DOS Lock on the named file and, if that fails, tries DOS Open and returns the handle. If both fail it saves the DOS error code with error code 2 and returns minus one. A successful lock is released again and the function returns minus one.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:108C
name: remove_locked_file_then_open
description: Locks the named file and, when the lock succeeds, unlocks it and deletes the file. It then tries DOS Open, and when that fails it saves the DOS error code with error code 2 and returns minus one.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:10F4
name: close_file_handle
description: Runs a stored callback first when its pointer is set, then closes the DOS file handle through the Close vector and returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1118
name: open_intuition_then_copy_name
description: Opens intuition.library through exec. When that fails it passes 20 to a routine. Otherwise it copies a length-prefixed name from the state block into a local buffer and passes its address with the dimensions 250 and 40 to a routine. It then calls that routine with the value 20.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:11CC
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values held in registers by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves. It returns the 32-bit fixed-point product.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:11EC
name: divide_signed_fixed_point
description: Divides two 32-bit fixed-point values, negating the result when exactly one operand is negative. When the divisor fits in 16 bits it divides directly, and otherwise it normalises the operands by shifting and performs a corrected 16-bit divide. It returns the 32-bit fixed-point quotient.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:121E
name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using normalised shifts and 16-bit divides. It returns a 64-bit result with the quotient in the high 32 bits and the remainder in the low 32 bits.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:12B0
name: report_message_cli_or_window
description: Copies a length-prefixed message into a local buffer, capped at 79 bytes. From a CLI task it writes the message and a newline to the output handle and returns minus one. Otherwise it opens intuition through exec, passes the message to a routine with dimensions 250 and 60, and returns zero on success.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:12D2
name: report_break_notice
description: Copies a counted run of bytes into a local buffer and terminates it. From a CLI task it writes the text and a newline to the output handle and returns minus one. Otherwise it opens intuition through exec and passes the buffer to a routine with dimensions 250 and 60, returning zero on success. The referenced text is a break-notice prefix.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1336
name: open_intuition_with_dimensions
description: Opens a library through exec and, when that succeeds, passes a window argument block with the dimensions 250 and 60 to a routine. It returns zero when that routine returns one and minus one otherwise.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:134E
name: store_buffer_and_open_window
description: Stores the address of a local buffer in the state block, then passes the state fields together with the dimensions 250 and 60 to a routine. It returns zero when that routine returns one and minus one otherwise.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1386
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other work and no memory access. It is referenced by address and called by three unnamed routines.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:13DC
name: close_record_handle_checked
description: Looks up a record through a routine and returns minus one if it is missing. For a record without flag value 16 it closes the record's handle and clears its first word, returning zero unless an error flag is set. A record with that flag set is only cleared and returns zero.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1424
name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Clears the error code and checks a table index against the table count and whether the entry is in use. An index that is out of range or unused stores error code 9 and returns zero; otherwise it returns the address of the table entry.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:1464
name: check_break_signal_callback
description: Reads the task signal state through SetSignal and, when the break-signal bits are set and a callback is stored, runs the callback. If the callback returns non-zero it clears the stored pointer and passes 20 to a routine.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:1:14B0
name: allocate_zeroed_block
description: Obtains a size from a routine and allocates that many bytes through another routine. When the allocation succeeds every byte of the block is cleared to zero. It returns the block, or null when the allocation fails.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0000
name: write_installer_file_records
description: A large installer routine of about 764 instructions that begins with a stack-limit check and appends a bounded string. Its visible code opens a file, writes a series of fixed text and byte fields through the handle, loops over a table of further entries and calls the Lock, Write, Delay and UnLock stubs. The listing is truncated before its end.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0B1C
name: release_handle_return_pointer
description: Calls a routine with the stored file handle and then calls another routine with zero, returning the pointer that second call produces. A stack-limit branch appends a bounded string and returns the destination pointer instead.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0B36
name: release_state_values_pointer
description: Passes two stored state values to routines and returns the pointer from a third call made with one. A stack-limit branch appends a bounded string and returns the destination pointer instead.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0B5E
name: read_three_bytes_return_first
description: Reads three bytes from the stored file handle into a state buffer through the Read stub. It returns the first byte when fewer than two bytes were read, and null otherwise.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0B8C
name: write_value_to_handle
description: Passes a value through a routine and writes the result to the stored file handle through the Write stub, returning the resulting pointer. A stack-limit branch appends a bounded string instead.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:rinstall:2:0BBA
name: retry_until_nonzero_result
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a non-zero pointer and returns that pointer. A stack-limit branch appends a bounded string instead.

description: Launches a Workbench tool. key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:CREDITS.EXE:0:00BE
